commit_message:
[Merged] Fix some problems with using fts5 options 'secure-delete' and detail=none together.

FossilOrigin-Name: 4d3f27ba90aa59837e49ceaae9f36cad426af3a33707d85d1bb848fc1bda6fed
pr_title: Support FTS5 secure-delete with detail=none and validate record offsets
pr_description: Handle FTS5 secure-delete operations with detail=none, including rowid boundaries and overflow pages. Validate the starting record offset against the page size before decoding its varint; if the offset exceeds the page size, report index corruption, release the temporary index buffer, and return.

intro_commit_message:
Fix some problems with using fts5 options 'secure-delete' and detail=none together.

FossilOrigin-Name: 4d3f27ba90aa59837e49ceaae9f36cad426af3a33707d85d1bb848fc1bda6fed
fix_commit_message:
Fix another buffer overread in fts5 that could occur when processing corrupt records. Bug [bugs:/info/2026-06-03T03:54:40Z | 2026-06-03T03:54:40Z].

FossilOrigin-Name: b5337c87cc314e6830615e4efe2d4723fa7cedf87ce404f60d6e520aeab77cbc
agent_reasoning: The secure-delete path could use a 16-bit offset from corrupt page data as an unchecked buffer index, causing an out-of-bounds read. The added iStart>nPg guard matches the supplied source change and prevents that read while freeing aIdx and reporting index corruption. Only ext/fts5/fts5_index.c was edited; no test files or generated manifest metadata were changed. Workspace validation passed against intro_parent.
